_comment: Voice-over for scenes 1-4 (0:00-0:46). start = seconds from the start of the video (global). until = latest second the line may end (the next visual beat). 'on screen' is what the picture does at that moment. Edit text freely; only changed lines are regenerated.

lines.text: All they know is one number from their bill.
lines.on screen: caption 'A homeowner wants solar. This is all they know.' (2.3-4.7); quote card rises (5.0)
number flies into the field (5.1-5.8); cursor moves (6.8) and clicks Get quote (7.8)
'Thanks! We'll call you back.' (8.2) then the clock (9.7)

lines.text: On the other side, an installer gets another lead that starts from zero.
lines.on screen: split: homeowner left, installer right (12.0); lead list (13.4); profile with ? marks (15.0)

lines.text: A planner will spend hours turning it into a design and a price.
Reonic already connects installers and their customers.
lines.on screen: after the bubble dies in the gap (21-23): 'Reonic already connects the two.' (24.5)
'We wanted to go further' (28.2), 'further' wipes to gradient (28.7)
Reonic becomes reo: slide (32.25), turn (33.5), arms (34.55), wave (34.9), lockup (35.9)

lines.text: An agentic companion, dropped onto the installer's website, doing the work in between.
lines.on screen: site rises (38.2), reo drops in (39.5-40.1), sites slide through (40.5-43.6), gap returns (43.6)

lines.text: On Sonnfeld's website, an advisor talks to the homeowner.
lines.on screen: bubble grows into the window (46.0); pointer clicks Plan my home (47.4); advisor sheet opens
address typed (51.9), Find roof (53.2); the roof glows (53.7)
Planned clicked (55.7); car and wallbox appear

lines.text: And they get a design, a price range,
lines.on screen: results wide view (58-61), push to the price range marked estimate (62.6)

lines.text: and a reason for every number.
lines.on screen: pointer taps Savings (64.8); the advisor explains on the house

lines.text: Tap any number, and the advisor explains it.
lines.on screen: Send plan (66.8-68.7): name typed, Send plan clicked; sent banner (70.3)
